{{Quote|Resume, AX/RX. Until he is oblivious. Then put him with the boy. I have other business to tend to.|Kh'aris Fenn to AX/RX about Jedi Master Tholme|<ref name="SW44">[[Star Wars (1998) 43|''Star Wars'' (1998) 43]]</ref>}}
'''AX/RX''' was a modified [[MD-series medical droid/Legends|MD-series medical droid]] owned by [[Kh'aris Fenn]] and was active in [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]]. Kh'aris used it as a [[Torture/Legends|torture]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]], utilizing its knowledge of the anatomy to inflict maximum pain.

==Biography==
[[File:AXRX.jpg|thumb|left|AX/RX torturing Tholme.]]
Fenn used AX/RX to make [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]] surrender. Kh'aris ordered the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to keep [[Torture/Legends|torturing]] the Jedi until he was oblivious. After Tholme used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to drop his life signs, AX/RX put the Jedi in a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] cell with [[Nat Secura]].

When [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] and [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] infiltrated Kh'aris' fortress, Kh'aris ordered the execution of his two prisoners. Tholme resisted but AX/RX electronic defense mechanism [[Death/Legends|killed]] the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]&mdash;at least that was what AX/RX determined. When AX/RX neared Nat, Tholme stood up and used his [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] to throw AX/RX into the prison wall. AX/RX survived and began shocking the Jedi again only to be [[Sai cha/Legends|beheaded]] by another Jedi, Aayla Secura.
